column1: # RAW values for Origin's Histogram tool (Statistics > Histogram).
# One value per structure: |screen_dV_over_V0| x 100, in percent.
# Two columns of different length - blanks at the bottom of the shorter one are normal.
# In Origin: select BOTH columns > Plot > Statistics > Histogram, then set Bin Size = 2.
# ** Do NOT use this file with a Column chart, and do NOT use the pre-binned file with Histogram. **
